桃花山刘家修仙传最新章节_第23章 在路上第1页_桃花山刘家修仙传飞云剑仙_热点小说网
> 第23章 在路上（第1页）
当刘长旭三人穿行在一处丛林中时。突然，小青停下来了脚步，紧张的看着丛林深处，并神魂传音告诉主人，丛林深处有妖兽。
二长老刘秋水，也感觉到了空气中的一丝淡淡的妖气。
向刘长旭二人示意后，二长老刘秋水手持法器长剑，不停扫视丛林深处。
刘长旭和五哥刘长顺也从储物袋中取出了自己的法器，运用灵眼术扫视丛林深处。
由于林木等遮挡物众多，用灵眼术根本看不到妖兽的踪迹，只有从周围寂静而紧张的气息中，察觉到附近存在着强大的妖兽！
时间一点点过去！一阵妖风袭来，一只身形高大的妖虎出现在三人的视线中，这是一只一阶大圆满烈焰虎。
二长老刘秋水见状，赶紧向大长老刘秋生发了一道传音符，将这里的情况进行了通报，并请求家族支援。
烈焰虎很快来到三人面前，吐出一团又一团橘红色的烈焰打向三人，这一团团的烈焰可比刘长旭火球术威力大的多。
刘长旭连忙祭出一张一阶上品土墙符，挡在自己面前，接着又掐动法诀发动木藤术。
于是，一根根绿色的藤蔓缠绕在烈焰虎身上，烈焰虎很快就挣断了藤蔓，但是，很快又有藤蔓缠绕在其身上，虽然，不能影响烈焰虎的行动，但是，也使得其行动速度得以放缓！
在烈焰虎速度放缓之际，二长老刘秋水和五哥刘长顺抓住机会向烈焰虎猛攻，二长老刘秋水御使的法剑如一道飞虹斩向烈焰虎的脖颈，烈焰虎不愧为一阶大圆满妖兽，虽然身形高大，但仍轻松的躲过二长老刘秋水的这一击。
倒是五哥刘长顺的盘龙棍狠狠的打在烈焰虎的背部。
奈何烈焰虎肉身强大，只是让烈焰虎身形微晃，并未受伤。
一阶大圆满妖兽的战力果然不一般。
特别是对施展木藤术术的刘长旭，甚是讨厌，直接便将火球攻击重点的对准了刘长旭。
随着一团团烈焰向着刘长旭袭来，大大的影响了刘长旭的施法节奏。
恢复了速度的烈焰虎立刻凶威大盛！将刘长旭三人搞得甚是忙乱！
见此情况，刘长旭说道到：“七太爷！五哥！咋们这么打很被动啊！”

二长老刘秋水想了想说道：“是啊！长旭你有什么想法？说出来吧！”
刘长旭：“我的意见是七太爷负责攻击，我负责迟滞烈焰虎的速度，五哥你负责防守如何！”
二长老刘秋水说道：“这个主意不错，可以！”
五哥刘长顺也说道：“你们怎么说，我就怎么办。”
说完后三人开始行动起来，二长老刘秋水不断御使飞剑发动猛攻，炙热的飞剑如长虹贯日，不断向着烈焰虎而去。
刘长旭则是不断掐动法诀施展缠绕术，迟滞烈焰虎的行动
而刘长顺则负责帮助刘长旭抵挡来自烈焰虎的攻击。
随着时间的推移，三人的配合越来越熟练，而烈焰虎身上的伤势则慢慢的多起来。
刘长旭三人越战越勇，烈焰虎则是心生退意。
但为时已晚，刘家的支援队伍已经到了。

The latest chapter of The Legend of the Liu Family in Taohuashan_Chapter 23 On the Road Page 1_The Legend of the Liu Family in Taohuashan Feiyun Sword Immortal_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 23 On the Road (Page 1)
When Liu Changxu and three others were walking through a jungle. Suddenly, Xiao Qing stopped, looked nervously into the depths of the jungle, and sent a message from his soul to tell his master that there were monsters deep in the jungle.
The second elder, Liu Qiushui, also felt a faint hint of evil spirit in the air.
After signaling to Liu Changxu and Liu Changxu, the second elder Liu Qiushui held a magic weapon and a long sword and kept scanning the depths of the jungle.
Liu Changxu and fifth brother Liu Changshun also took out their magic weapons from their storage bags and used spiritual eyes to scan the depths of the jungle.
Due to the numerous obstructions such as trees, no trace of the monster beast could be seen using the spiritual eye technique. Only from the quiet and tense atmosphere around, one could detect the presence of a powerful monster beast nearby!
Time passes little by little! A gust of demonic wind struck, and a tall demonic tiger appeared in the sight of the three people. This was a first-order Dzogchen Flame Tiger.
Upon seeing this, Second Elder Liu Qiushui quickly sent a transmission note to First Elder Liu Qiusheng, informing him of the situation here and asking for family support.
The flaming tiger quickly came to the three of them and spit out balls of orange-red flames at the three of them. These balls of flames were much more powerful than Liu Changxu's fireball technique.
Liu Changxu quickly held out a first-grade high-quality earthen wall talisman and blocked it in front of him, and then used the magic formula to activate the wood vine technique.
As a result, green vines wrapped around the Flame Tiger. The Flame Tiger quickly broke the vines, but soon there were vines wrapped around it. Although it could not affect the action of the Flame Tiger, it also slowed down its action!
When the flaming tiger slowed down, the second elder Liu Qiu Shui and the fifth brother Liu Changshun seized the opportunity to attack the flaming tiger. The magic sword of the second elder Liu Qiu Shui's envoy struck at the neck of the flaming tiger like a flying rainbow. The flaming tiger was worthy of being a first-order Dzogchen monster. Although it was tall, it still easily dodged the blow of the second elder Liu Qiu Shui.
On the other hand, fifth brother Liu Changshun hit the Flame Tiger hard on the back with his Panlong Stick.
However, the Flame Tiger's physical body was so powerful that it only caused the Flame Tiger's figure to sway slightly but was not injured.
The combat power of the first-order Dzogchen monster is indeed extraordinary.
In particular, he was very disgusted with Liu Changxu, who used the Wooden Vine Technique, and directly aimed the fireball attack at Liu Changxu.
As balls of flames attacked Liu Changxu, Liu Changxu's spell casting rhythm was greatly affected.
The flaming tiger regained its speed and immediately became fierce and powerful! The three of them, Liu Changxu, were in a state of confusion!
Seeing this situation, Liu Changxu said: "Seventh Master! Fifth Brother! Why are you so passive when fighting like this!"
Second Elder Liu Qiushui thought for a moment and said, "Yes! Changxu, what do you think? Tell me!"
Liu Changxu: "My opinion is that the Seventh Master is responsible for attacking, I am responsible for slowing down the Flame Tiger, and Fifth Brother, you are responsible for the defense!"
Second Elder Liu Qiushui said: "This is a good idea, yes!"
Fifth brother Liu Changshun also said: "Whatever you say, I will do."
After saying that, the three of them started to take action. The second elder Liu Qiushui kept using the flying sword to launch fierce attacks. The hot flying sword was like a rainbow penetrating the sun, and kept moving towards the flaming tiger.
Liu Changxu, on the other hand, kept using the magic formula to perform the entanglement technique, delaying the action of the Flame Tiger.
Liu Changshun is responsible for helping Liu Changxu resist the attack from the Flame Tiger.
As time went by, the three of them became more and more skilled in their cooperation, and the injuries on the Blazing Tiger slowly increased.
Liu Changxu and the others became more and more courageous as they fought, while Lieyanhu was determined to give up.
But it was too late, the Liu family's support team had already arrived.
